$comment: What code generated for mmt-dpi 1.10.2 uses from the SDK, and the header that declares each entry, relative to <prefix>/dpi/include. Taken from the headers of the published v1.10.2 package and checked against them in CI (python -m mmt_plugin.sdk.headercheck). Schema: mmt_plugin/schemas/sdk/v1/profile.json. Types are C type names; a parameter type never holds a function or array declarator, so '<type> <name>' declares it. A data_type constant's size is what get_data_size_by_data_type() returns for it (src/mmt_core/src/mmt_data.c of v1.10.2, on the LP64 targets amd64 and arm64): register_attribute_with_protocol() refuses a data_len above a nonzero size, and any nonzero data_len for a size of 0. The headers do not hold it, so headercheck cannot assert it; tests/unit/generate/test_compile.py checks it against libmmt_core.

headers.name: data_defs.h
headers.doc: Core types (ipacket_t, attribute_t, protocol_t, mmt_session_t), the packet accessors and the classification status values.

headers.name: types_defs.h
headers.doc: The MMT_* attribute data types (enum data_types), mac_addr_t and the address and binary data lengths.

headers.name: mmt_core.h
headers.doc: The attribute scopes, POSITION_NOT_KNOWN, and the VERSION macro that SDK detection reads.

headers.name: plugin_defs.h
headers.doc: The plugin callback typedefs, attribute_metadata_t, classified_proto_t and the registration calls.

headers.name: extraction_lib.h
headers.doc: The general_* extraction functions for fixed-width attributes.

headers.name: mmt_utils.h
headers.doc: Utility helpers of libmmt_core (hexadecimal conversions); mmt_core.h includes it.

headers.name: mmt_log.h
headers.doc: The SDK logger. No other installed header includes it: a plugin that logs includes it itself.

headers.name: mmt_class_provider.h
headers.doc: The application and content class provider a plugin may register from init_proto().

headers.name: proto_meta.h
headers.doc: The ids of the core's pseudo-protocols, PROTO_UNKNOWN and PROTO_META; mmt_core.h includes it.

headers.name: tcpip/mmt_tcpip.h
headers.doc: The ids of the libmmt_tcpip protocols, the parents most plugins classify under.

types.name: mmt_proto_index_t
types.doc: The index of a protocol in a packet's protocol path; the Java generator's int is wrong here.

types.name: mmt_opaque_t
types.doc: An opaque context or key pointer passed back to callbacks.

types.name: protocol_t
types.doc: The opaque protocol structure being registered.

types.name: mac_addr_t
types.doc: A MAC address (an array of ETH_ALEN bytes); sizeof(mac_addr_t) is the data_len of an MMT_DATA_MAC_ADDR attribute.

types.name: mmt_classify_verdict_t
types.doc: What a classification callback returns, in C (C++ sees int).

structs.name: attribute_metadata_t
structs.doc: One row of the generated attribute table, written as a positional initializer, so every field is listed, in order.

structs.name: classified_proto_t
structs.doc: What the stack classification returns and set_classified_proto() records.

structs.name: mmt_class_provider_t
structs.doc: A plugin's class lookups; NULL for what it does not class.

structs.name: ipacket_t
structs.doc: The packet being processed; generated code reads only these fields (packet_id in log lines).

structs.name: pkthdr_t
structs.doc: The packet's capture metadata; caplen bounds every read of ipacket->data.

structs.name: attribute_t
structs.doc: The attribute an extraction function fills; it writes the value to data.

structs.name: mmt_binary_data_t
structs.doc: The value of an MMT_BINARY_DATA or MMT_STRING_DATA attribute (data_len BINARY_64DATA_TYPE_LEN): the byte count, then at most 64 bytes.

structs.name: mmt_binary_var_data_t
structs.doc: The value of an MMT_BINARY_VAR_DATA attribute (data_len sizeof(mmt_binary_var_data_t)): the byte count, then at most 1024 bytes.

callbacks.doc: Classifies a packet whose stack starts with this protocol (register_protocol_stack).
Recognises this protocol above the layer at previous_index: records it with set_classified_proto() and returns MMT_CLASSIFY_MATCHED, or MMT_CLASSIFY_SKIP.
Creates the protocol context; returns it.
Sets up the protocol's per-session data on a session's first packet.
Analyses each packet of a session after classification.
Finds or creates the packet's session; sets *is_new for a new one.
The entry point the SDK looks up by the name init_proto when it loads the plugin; positive on success, 0 otherwise.

registrations.name: init_protocol_struct_for_registration
registrations.doc: Starts registering a protocol; NULL when the id is taken.

registrations.name: register_attribute_with_protocol
registrations.doc: Registers one row of the attribute table.

registrations.name: register_classification_function
registrations.doc: Registers the classifier of the protocols this one encapsulates.

registrations.name: register_classification_function_with_parent_protocol
registrations.doc: Registers this protocol's classifier under a parent; weight 0-9 or 90-100, lower runs first. Fails when the parent is not registered yet (load order).

registrations.name: register_proto_context_init_cleanup_function
registrations.doc: Registers the protocol context callbacks (the Java generator's register_proto_context_cleanup_function does not exist).

registrations.name: register_session_data_initialization_function
registrations.doc: Registers the session data init callback.

registrations.name: register_session_data_cleanup_function
registrations.doc: Registers the session data cleanup callback.

registrations.name: register_session_data_analysis_function
registrations.doc: Registers the session data analysis callback.

registrations.name: register_sessionizer_function
registrations.doc: Registers the sessionizer and its cleanup and key comparison callbacks.

registrations.name: register_protocol_stack
registrations.doc: Registers a protocol stack that starts with this protocol.

registrations.name: register_protocol
registrations.doc: Ends the registration; init_proto() returns its result.

registrations.name: mmt_register_class_provider
registrations.doc: Registers the class provider, from init_proto(); it must stay valid until close_extraction().

helpers.name: set_classified_proto
helpers.doc: Records the protocol a classifier recognised; nonzero when recorded.

helpers.name: get_packet_offset_at_index
helpers.doc: The offset in the packet of the protocol at an index of its path.

helpers.name: get_protocol_id_by_name
helpers.doc: The id of a registered protocol (names compare case-insensitively), 0 when none: init_proto() refuses a taken name.

helpers.name: general_short_extraction_with_ordering_change
helpers.doc: Extracts a 2-byte attribute in network byte order (MMT_U16_DATA). general_short_extraction is deprecated and not listed.

helpers.name: general_int_extraction
helpers.doc: Extracts a 4-byte attribute in host byte order (MMT_U32_DATA).

helpers.name: general_int_extraction_with_ordering_change
helpers.doc: Extracts a 4-byte attribute in network byte order (MMT_U32_DATA).

helpers.name: hex2int
helpers.doc: The value of one hexadecimal digit character.

helpers.name: str_hex2int_n
helpers.doc: The value of the hexadecimal digits hstr[start_index..end_index], never reading past hstr_len bytes; -1 for a bad range. str_hex2int is deprecated and not listed.

constants.name: Max_Alias_Len
constants.doc: The longest protocol or attribute alias, in bytes.

constants.name: PROTO_MAX_IDENTIFIER
constants.doc: A protocol id is positive and below this value.

constants.name: PROTO_UNKNOWN
constants.doc: The id of the unknown pseudo-protocol; no plugin may take it.

constants.name: PROTO_META
constants.doc: The id of the META pseudo-protocol, present in every packet; no plugin may take it.

constants.name: MMT_CLASSIFY_SKIP
constants.doc: A classifier did not recognise the protocol.

constants.name: POSITION_NOT_KNOWN
constants.doc: Used as an attribute's position_in_packet (offset) when the attribute has no fixed offset.

constants.name: IPv6_ALEN
constants.doc: Used as the data_len of an MMT_DATA_IP6_ADDR attribute: an IPv6 address, in bytes.

constants.name: BINARY_64DATA_TYPE_LEN
constants.doc: Used as the data_len of an MMT_BINARY_DATA attribute: an int length and 64 data bytes.

constants.name: MMT_CLASS_UNKNOWN
constants.doc: What a class lookup returns for a key it does not know.

macros.name: mmt_log_error
macros.doc: Logs one printf-style line at the error level.

macros.name: mmt_log_warn
macros.doc: Logs one printf-style line at the warn level.

macros.name: mmt_log_info
macros.doc: Logs one printf-style line at the info level.

macros.name: mmt_log_debug
macros.doc: Logs one printf-style line at the debug level; compiled out unless the plugin defines the debug opt-in.

logger.doc: Generated code logs only through these macros (stderr, off by default, rate-limited); a plugin's own DEBUG does not enable mmt_log_debug(), -DMMT_LOG_ENABLE_DEBUG does.

class_provider.doc: A plugin that classes its protocols fills a static mmt_class_provider_t and registers it from init_proto().

ids.doc: libmmt_tcpip: the TCP/IP protocols, from Ethernet to applications (PROTO_CLASS_* are classes, not protocols).
libmmt_tmobile: the mobile network protocols (S1AP, Diameter, GTPv2, NGAP, 5G NAS).
libmmt_business_app: IPS_DATA, positions read from a CSV file.

parents.doc: A parent protocol of libmmt_tcpip is named by the macro PROTO_<LABEL>, with LABEL its upper-case label; the examples are the parents of the corpus models. A parent from another plugin comes from that plugin's header. ids lists, per header, the id and the registered name (PROTO_<X>_ALIAS) of every protocol of the four plugins the 1.10.2 package installs (libmmt_tcpip, libmmt_tdicom, libmmt_tmobile, libmmt_business_app).
